sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:163818
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 50037 of 2021
Applicant :- Shivam

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ved Ratan,Mohd. Salim Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dhirendra Kumar Verma
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Case called out.
None appeared on behalf of the informant.
However, learned AGA for the State is present.

2. Heard Sri Rakesh Kumar Maurya, Advocate holding brief of Sri Ved Ratan, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 376 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Khurja,
District Bulandshahar during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his mother and according to the FIR niece of the informant performed marriage with the applicant according to her own wish about a year before but after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for dowry and on 19.06.2019 they have strangulated her.

Shivam vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3708092/
1

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and actually applicant and deceased performed love marriage and there was no occasion for the applicant to strangulate his wife.

He further submits that actually informant i.e. uncle of the deceased was not happy with the love marriage of the deceased, therefore, he along with his other family members committed the murder of the deceased in absence of the applicant.

He further submits that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 21.06.2019 i.e. for more than four years and till date trial of the case could not be concluded, therefore, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
6.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife was strangulated in her matrimonial home and according the statement of land lady of the applicant and deceased, it appears that only applicant was residing with the deceased and applicant miserably failed to explain the homicidal death of his wife, therefore, he does not deserve bail.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Although, in the present matter applicant is in jail for more than four years but he is facing trial under Section 304B IPC, in which, maximum punishment is life imprisonment and post mortem report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to strangulation, therefore, it is a case of homicidal death.

Further, from the statement of land lady, which was recorded by the Investigating Officer, it appears that applicant and deceased alone were residing in the house and applicant did not explain the homicidal death of his wife.

9. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

11. However, considering the fact that applicant is in jail for more than four years, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case within eight months from the date of production of certified copy of this order strictly as per provision of Section 309 Cr.P.C. without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 11.8.2023 AK Pandey  Shivam vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3708092/
